blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Energy (DOE) must address the issues surrounding the planned Semirara coal auction, as ongoing uncertainties threaten the country’s baseload power. During a privileged speech, Pangasinan 2nd District Rep. Mark Cojuangco highlighted mounting issues in the energy sector, particularly regarding the coal mine auction. READ: Japanese business chamber questions DOE-DENR asset-surrender rule He described it as “murky and chaotic,” following the release of proposed rules and the alleged lack of transparency in the process.“What should have been a transparent, straightforward administrative process has instead degenerated into a legal and operational mess,” he said.
